tok 1.0 "Bicycle order"

pool company "Bicycle company"
  lane sales "Sales department"
    start received "Order received"
    xor decide "Order accepted?"
    task reject "Reject the order"
    task accept "Accept the order"
    and inform
    task ship "Ship the bicycle"
    end rejected "Order rejected"
    end shipped "Bicycle shipped"
  lane store "Storehouse"
    sub parts "Process the part list"
      start item "Part to process"
      task check "Check the required quantity"
      xor avail "Part available?"
      task reserve "Reserve the part"
      task backorder "Back-order the part"
      xor merge
      end done "Part processed"
      flow item -> check -> avail
      flow avail -> reserve "yes"
      flow avail -> backorder "no"
      flow reserve -> merge
      flow backorder -> merge
      flow merge -> done
  lane eng "Engineering department"
    task prepare "Prepare the assembling"
    and joined
    task assemble "Assemble the bicycle"

flow received -> decide
flow decide -> reject "no"
flow decide -> accept "yes"
flow reject -> rejected
flow accept -> inform
flow inform -> parts
flow inform -> prepare
flow parts -> joined
flow prepare -> joined
flow joined -> assemble -> ship -> shipped
